home.title: Call of Block | Competitive Minecraft PvP & Battle Royale
home.description: Call of Block is a competitive Minecraft PvP shooter featuring Battle Royale, Deathmatch, Zombie Survival, guns, vehicles, destruction, parkour, leaderboards, player profiles and tactical match replays.

stats.title: Call of Block Stats Tracker | Minecraft PvP Leaderboards
stats.description: Explore Call of Block Minecraft PvP leaderboards, player profiles, weapon and map statistics, match history, personal records and tactical match replays.
stats.heading: Call of Block Stats Tracker
intro: Compare Battle Royale, Deathmatch, Duel and Zombie Survival results from tracked Call of Block matches.
Open a player profile for mode records, weapons, maps and match history. Detailed tactical telemetry loads only when a replay is opened.

playtests.title: Call of Block Playtests | Join Minecraft PvP Testing
playtests.description: Join Call of Block community playtests, vote for available dates and help test experimental Minecraft Battle Royale, Deathmatch, Duel and Zombie Survival features.
playtests.heading: Call of Block Playtests
intro: Vote for dates and availability for upcoming Call of Block Minecraft PvP testing sessions.
Confirmed events appear with their local date and time. Discord sign-in is required only for account-linked voting and notifications.

feedback.title: Call of Block Feedback & Support
feedback.description: Report Call of Block bugs, suspected cheating, balance concerns, website problems or account issues, and follow replies through the private support ticket system.
feedback.heading: Call of Block Feedback & Support
intro: Send bug reports, cheat reports, balance feedback, suggestions and account or website support requests to the Call of Block team.
Signed-in players can attach evidence, save a draft locally and review only their own support tickets.

help.title: Call of Block Help | Server, Accounts and Stats
help.description: Find Call of Block help for joining the Minecraft server, linking Discord and Minecraft accounts, understanding statistics, using player commands and resolving common issues.
help.heading: Call of Block Help
intro: Find current player instructions for joining Call of Block, linking accounts, reading tracked statistics and using public in-game commands.
The How to Play and FAQ sections also cover server access, playtests, profiles, privacy and website safety.

about.title: About Call of Block | Competitive Minecraft PvP Project
about.description: Learn about Call of Block, an independently developed competitive Minecraft PvP project combining guns, vehicles, destruction, parkour, statistics and tactical replays.
about.heading: About Call of Block
intro: Call of Block is an independent Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge project built around competitive PvP, community playtests and transparent player statistics.
Its available and experimental modes combine TacZ weapons, Superb Warfare vehicles, Parcool movement, destructible maps and server-authoritative match tracking.
